models.note: fine-tuned on the device's real shots (batches 1-2, HARDWARE); the cascade's prior and tau chosen on validation; scored on the held-out batch 3
models.inputs: detection events only (no observables, no leakage flags)

cascade.rule: one standard error: the smallest tau whose validation failures exceed the argmin tau's by at most sqrt(b + c), b and c the shots on which only one of the two fails (the argmin tau is recorded)

prior_choice.rule: calibrated unless uniform-weight correlated MWPM fails fewer validation shots by more than sqrt(b + c), b and c the shots on which only one of the two fails
